patterns.name: Hidden Mint Function
patterns.description: Owner-only function that can mint unlimited tokens
patterns.recommendation: Remove owner-only mint or add hard supply cap

patterns.name: Owner Can Pause Transfers
patterns.description: Owner can freeze all token transfers, trapping user funds
patterns.recommendation: Add timelock or multi-sig requirement for pause operations

patterns.name: Blacklist Capability
patterns.description: Owner can blacklist addresses from transferring tokens
patterns.recommendation: Remove blacklist capability or require governance approval

patterns.name: Drain Function
patterns.description: Function that sends all contract funds to owner
patterns.recommendation: Remove arbitrary fund withdrawal or add timelock

patterns.name: Modifiable Fee Structure
patterns.description: Owner can change fees to any value including 100%
patterns.recommendation: Add maximum fee cap enforced in the setter

patterns.name: Raw Call to External Address
patterns.description: Low-level raw_call can execute arbitrary code at any address
patterns.recommendation: Avoid raw_call. Use typed interfaces for external calls

patterns.name: Mutable Owner Without Renounce
patterns.description: Contract owner can be changed but never renounced
patterns.recommendation: Add renounce_ownership function for trustless operation

patterns.name: Hidden Selfdestruct
patterns.description: Contract can be destroyed by owner, stealing all funds
patterns.recommendation: Remove selfdestruct — it's deprecated and dangerous

patterns.name: Unrestricted Delegatecall
patterns.description: Delegatecall with controllable target can execute arbitrary code

patterns.name: Multiple Admin Roles
patterns.description: Contract has multiple privileged roles that can perform admin actions
patterns.recommendation: Document all admin roles and use multi-sig governance

patterns.name: Reentrancy Risk
patterns.description: External call before state update — reentrancy vector

patterns.name: Missing Nonreentrant Guard
patterns.description: External function with value transfer missing @nonreentrant
patterns.recommendation: Add @nonreentrant decorator to functions with external calls

patterns.name: Unchecked Send Return
patterns.description: Return value of send() not checked — funds may silently fail
patterns.recommendation: Always check the return value of send()

patterns.name: Block Timestamp Dependence
patterns.description: Using block.timestamp for critical logic — can be manipulated
